# pylutron-caseta test responses

LEAP answers of a Caséta bridge (`*.json`), a RadioRA 3 processor (`ra3/`)
and a HomeWorks QSX processor (`hwqsx/`), copied verbatim from the tests of
[pylutron-caseta](https://github.com/gurumitts/pylutron-caseta)
(`tests/responses/`, commit `c0dcc22`, 2026-10-05), Apache-2.0 (see
`NOTICE`). They cover the device types the maintainer does not own (shades,
fans, occupancy sensors, keypads); `test/helpers/pylutronBridge.js` serves
them from the fake bridge.
